fact: NOSi's activity plan and budget for 2024 says the Council of Ministers approved in January 2024, for execution by July 2024, the sale of the physical wide-area component of the RTPE, which is to work from then only as the state's logical network, that NOSi's restructuring is financed by the Government through the Digital Cabo Verde programme with World Bank support, and that 2024 work includes converting the Municipal Information System to SIMple; it does not name municipal councils among the RTPE's connections and gives no count.
title: Plano de Atividades e Orçamento 2024
